title: Mermaid Animator sidecar
description: Animation settings, narration and layout for the Mermaid diagrams of the file this sidecar sits beside (`<file>.animator.json`).

diagrams.description: Entries keyed by the diagram's `@id`, or by `#<index>` (1-based position in the file).

settings.description: Settings for this diagram, above user and workspace settings and below front matter and annotations.

playback.autoplay.markdownDescription: Start playing when a panel opens.

playback.dwell.markdownDescription: How long each step rests before the next one plays.
enumDescriptions: Reading time based on the length of the label and caption.

playback.dwellMs.markdownDescription: Rest time in milliseconds when `playback.dwell` is `fixed`.

playback.onEnd.markdownDescription: What happens when autoplay reaches the last step.
enumDescriptions: Return to the beginning and stop.
Play the step backwards at double speed.

playback.pauseOnHover.markdownDescription: Pause autoplay while the pointer is over the diagram.

playback.startAt.markdownDescription: Where playback starts when a panel opens.

playback.notes.markdownDescription: How notes take part in playback.
enumDescriptions: Each note is its own step.
Notes appear with the preceding step.

scrubber.snap.markdownDescription: Snap to the nearest step when you release the scrubber.

display.futureSteps.markdownDescription: How steps that have not played yet are shown.

display.pastSteps.markdownDescription: How steps that have played are shown.
enumDescriptions: Fading with age over the last steps.

display.trailLength.markdownDescription: Number of recent steps in the trail.

playback.initialOverview.markdownDescription: Show the complete diagram before the first step as an overview; the first step clears it and the reveal starts. Diagrams can override it with `%% @animator overview=false`.

motion.profile.markdownDescription: Character of the animation. `formal` uses decelerating curves without overshoot.

motion.respectReducedMotion.markdownDescription: Use minimal motion when the editor or the operating system asks for reduced motion.

motion.travelIndicator.markdownDescription: Indicator that travels along each message as it is drawn.
enumDescriptions: A pulse with a short tail.

camera.mode.markdownDescription: How the camera behaves during playback.
enumDescriptions: Fit small diagrams; follow large ones.
Keep the current step in view.
Frame each step tightly, gliding between steps.

camera.playZoom.markdownDescription: Zoom, in percent, at which a following camera frames steps during normal playback. Your own zoom replaces it until another diagram is opened.

camera.presentationZoom.markdownDescription: Zoom, in percent, at which the camera frames steps in presentation mode. Your own zoom while presenting replaces it until another diagram is opened.

playback.loopIterations.markdownDescription: How many times loops play when `@iterations` is not given.

playback.compressRepeats.markdownDescription: Play loop repetitions after the first at double speed.

playback.altBranches.markdownDescription: Which branches of `alt` and `critical` fragments play (`@branch` and the inspector override it).
enumDescriptions: Stop and ask which branch to play.

playback.parallel.markdownDescription: How the lanes of `par` fragments play.
enumDescriptions: Together: the k-th step of every lane at once.

display.showCaptions.markdownDescription: Show the caption strip for steps with `@caption`.

display.showInspector.markdownDescription: Show the inspector beside the diagram on wide panels (toggle with `D`).

presentation.chapterCards.markdownDescription: Introduce each chapter with a card during presentations.

view.default.markdownDescription: The view a panel opens in (`%% @animator view=` overrides it).
enumDescriptions: Participants in columns, messages in order.
Participants as a map of who talks to whom.
Both views side by side on one timeline.

topology.layout.markdownDescription: How the topology view places its nodes.
enumDescriptions: Layers in first-call order (computed off the main thread).
A force-directed map, identical every time for the same diagram.
Drag nodes; positions are remembered per diagram.

topology.direction.markdownDescription: Direction of the layered topology layout.

topology.returnMessages.markdownDescription: How return messages (dashed arrows) appear in the topology view.
enumDescriptions: As a dashed lane beside their request edge.

topology.edgeWeight.markdownDescription: Whether edge width grows with the number of messages.
enumDescriptions: Wider for more messages (up to 5 px).

display.showMinimap.markdownDescription: When to show the minimap in the corner of the canvas.
enumDescriptions: Only while the drawing is larger than the view.

display.participantNames.markdownDescription: Keep participants identifiable when their headers are out of view: a band at the top of the sequence view names the visible lifelines, and markers on the left and right edges point to participants of the current step that are off-screen.
enumDescriptions: Show the band and the markers when headers are out of view.

display.arrowEndNames.markdownDescription: Show the sender and receiver names at the ends of the message playing in the current step.
enumDescriptions: Only for participants whose header is out of view.

export.defaultFormat.markdownDescription: Format preselected in the export sheet.
enumDescriptions: MP4 video (H.264), where the editor supports it.
Animated SVG, plays as an image (for example in a GitHub README).
SVG image of the current frame.
PNG image of the current frame.

export.fps.markdownDescription: Frame rate for video exports. GIF uses 15 fps unless you set this.

export.background.markdownDescription: Export background: `theme`, `transparent` (where the format allows) or a colour such as `#ffffff`.

export.includeCaptions.markdownDescription: Burn captions into GIF and video exports.

export.svgAdaptiveTheme.markdownDescription: Also embed a `prefers-color-scheme: dark` palette in animated SVGs. Off by default because GitHub does not apply the viewer's theme to images predictably; use *Export for GitHub (light + dark pair)* instead.

export.theme.markdownDescription: Colour theme preselected in the export sheet, and used by *Export as SVG*, *Export as PNG* and *Copy Image*. `monochrome` is a formal style for documents and print: black text and lines, white shapes and background, light grey headers.
enumDescriptions: The panel's palette (animated SVG: GitHub-safe; HTML player: follow the viewer).
Monochrome: black on white, light grey headers.

propertyNames.description: A step: `#<step number>`, an `@step-id` slug, a content step id or a structural id.

chapters.description: Chapters, each starting at a step.

firstStep.description: A step: `#<step number>`, an `@step-id` slug, a content step id or a structural id.

layout.description: Topology layout; `manual` uses the positions below.

positions.description: Node centres by participant id, as `[x, y]`.

flowchart.description: Flowchart options (applied when flowcharts are animated natively).
